Dear AdSomeNoise team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Campaign Manager position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I bring a unique blend of analytical and technical skills that align well with your focus on performance and integration.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I use tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Google Ads to track performance and guide decisions. My hands-on experience with search campaigns and digital advertising platforms, combined with a strong test-and-learn mindset, makes me confident in my ability to manage campaigns from briefing to reporting.

I am particularly drawn to AdSomeNoise's collaborative approach, where strategy, creativity, media, and technology work together. I believe in transparency and integration, and I am eager to contribute to a team that values effectiveness and continuous improvement.

I would love the opportunity to discuss how I can help make every euro work harder for your clients. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Dear AdSomeNoise team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Campaign Manager position at AdSomeNoise. Your vision of an agency where strategy, creativity, media, and technology collaborate seamlessly resonates deeply with my own professional values. I believe that effective marketing requires breaking down silos and integrating data-driven insights with creative execution—exactly what you stand for.

With a few years of experience in digital marketing and a technical foundation in web development, I bring a unique perspective to campaign management. At Episto, I currently manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted content that grows organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring that technical performance supports campaign goals. My daily toolkit includes Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads—tools I use to track performance, identify optimization opportunities, and guide decisions.

What sets me apart is my hands-on experience with search campaigns and digital advertising platforms, combined with a strong test-and-learn mindset. I am constantly experimenting with new approaches, analyzing data, and refining strategies to achieve better results. I am also comfortable collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, having worked closely with content, design, and development colleagues.

I am particularly drawn to AdSomeNoise's commitment to transparency and integration. I believe that every euro should work harder, and I am eager to apply my analytical skills and common sense to deliver clear insights and recommendations to clients and colleagues alike.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team and grow together. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
